newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 16.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 16.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- EU applicant countries have received today the Commission's opinion.
- Hungary's Foreign Ministry has started to analyse the EU's opinion.
- A Budapest court has rejected the request of losing TV franchise bidder Irisz TV that the contracts signed with the two winners should be suspended.
- The situation after NATO invitations will be one of the topics of next week's Hungarian-Romanian foreign ministerial meeting in Cluj, Romania.
